rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Autonomath provides an 89-tool interface to Japanese regulatory databases covering subsidies, legal statutes, court decisions, tax systems, qualified business operators, procurement cases, administrative dispositions, bidding, and financing. The service is operated by Bookyou Inc. through the jpcite.com platform with pay-per-request pricing at ¥3 per request and 3 free requests per day for anonymous users. It surfaces primary-source data with a no-hallucination policy and structured response envelopes.
